bug_semantics: GuardDog extracted untrusted ZIP/wheel members with ZipFile.extract(member, path=os.path.join(target_directory, member)). extract() treats path as a trusted directory and then appends a sanitized member name; putting the raw member into path therefore skips zipfile's traversal stripping, double-appends the filename, and can write outside the intended extract directory when scanning a malicious PyPI package.
flaw_origin: ZIP support was added to fix scan failures on .zip/.whl (issue #104). The first extract implementation used path=os.path.join(unzippedpath, file) instead of path=unzippedpath. A same-day refactor moved that exact join into safe_extract() in guarddog/utils/archives.py (adding a comment that extract() sanitizes traversal) and GitHub squash-merged it to main; the join then survived until the 2.7.1 fix passed only the target directory.
